claims.claim_text: Skoda Group partnership announced Nov 5, 2025 to develop 'Made in Europe' battery systems using Microvast's 37Ah LTO cell; first prototype rail vehicles (EMUs) expected end of 2026, deployment from 2027.
claims.subject: Microvast
claims.object_value: Skoda Group, 37Ah LTO cell, ~95 Wh/kg, prototypes end-2026, deployment 2027
claims.source_quote: In November 5, 2025 we announced a partnership with koda Group to develop Made in Europe battery systems. The current solution under development utilizes Microvast's 37Ah LTO cell platform... The first prototype vehicles integrating the jointly developed battery electric multiple units are expected to be completed by the end of 2026 and are anticipated to be deployed starting in 2027.

claims.claim_text: Solid-state battery program: 'Currently, the energy density of the cell reaches 320 Wh/kg in bench scale validation.' Acknowledged 'prototype, bench-scale results may not be indicative of mass production performance.'
claims.subject: Microvast
claims.object_value: 320 Wh/kg solid-state cell, bench-scale only, no test conditions disclosed
claims.source_quote: Solid-State Battery Development: Since 2015, we have been working towards developing a 100% solid-state battery technology... Currently, the energy density of the cell reaches 320 Wh/kg in bench scale validation. Prototype, bench-scale results may not be indicative of mass production performance.

claims.claim_text: NMC 53.5Ah cell offers 235 Wh/kg, up to 6,000 cycles at 1C/room-temp with >80% SOH; production at Huzhou, China.
claims.subject: Microvast
claims.source_quote: One of our innovations is our high-energy NMC 53.5Ah battery cell, which offers an energy density of approximately 235 Wh/kg and supports up to 6,000 cycles at room temperature at a 1C rate while maintaining over 80% state of health (SOH)... To bring this product to market, we made substantial investments in fully automated production capacity in Huzhou, China.

claims.claim_text: Clarksville, TN facility (577,000 sq.ft. on 82 acres) is owned by Microvast for manufacturing, testing, ESS container assembly. Originally intended for 53.5Ah cells; now planned to produce LFP cells. Construction slowed in Q4 2023 due to financing; mechanics liens ($23.6M total) and $19.95M DPR Construction dispute exist.
claims.subject: Microvast
claims.object_value: Clarksville TN, 577,000 sq ft, manufacturing site, expansion incomplete
claims.source_quote: Clarksville, Tennessee United States 577,000 sq. ft. on 82 acres Manufacturing, testing, energy storage container assembly... Owned... because of delays in securing additional financing, in the fourth quarter of 2023 we began experiencing slow progress in continuing construction of our Clarksville expansion... DPR Construction... sought damages of $19,950 in progress billings...

claims.claim_text: Loss of conditional DOE grant referenced in multiple shareholder demands and securities litigation (Schelling v. Microvast). Company disclosed it is responding to demands investigating loss of DOE grant.
claims.subject: Microvast
claims.object_value: DOE conditional grant rescinded; subject of securities class action
claims.source_quote: The Company has received additional demands from purported Company stockholders, requesting that the Company's Board of Directors investigate... (2) the Company's loss of a conditional grant from the United States Department of Energy... Schelling v. Microvast Holdings, Inc... The complaint alleges that defendants violated certain federal securities laws by making misleading statements regarding the receipt of a conditional grant from the United States Department of Energy...

claims.claim_text: Going concern: initial substantial doubt raised about ability to continue operations within 12 months; cash + restricted cash $169.2M (only $105M unrestricted; $40.3M held in China subsidiary, $21.9M in Europe); convertible loan fair value $140.9M at SOFR+9.75%; stock at $2.10 vs warrant strike $11.50.
claims.subject: Microvast
claims.object_value: going concern doubt; $140.9M convertible loan at SOFR+9.75%; cash trapped abroad
claims.source_quote: These conditions initially raised substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern... cash, cash equivalents, and restricted cash totaling $169.2 million, of which $105.0 million was comprised in cash and cash equivalents. Of the cash and cash equivalents... $40.3 million is held by our China subsidiary and $21.9 million is held by our European subsidiaries... Convertible loan measured at fair value of $140.9 million. This loan bears interest at Term SOFR plus an applicable margin of 9.75%... trading price of our common stock was $2.10 as of March 9, 2026.

claims.claim_text: Order backlog of $196.1M as of FY2025 year-end, 'majority of which is expected to be fulfilled in 2026 and 2027.'
claims.subject: Microvast
claims.source_quote: Our order backlog stood at $196.1 million, the majority of which is expected to be fulfilled in 2026 and 2027.

claims.claim_text: Stated customer base includes IVECO (eDaily platform) and bus platforms Citybus/Intercity/Crossway, plus 'active collaborations' with BAIC Truck, Higer Bus, JBM Electric Vehicles; port/mining customers Kalmar Corp., XCMG, LGMG.
claims.subject: Microvast
claims.object_value: IVECO, BAIC Truck, Higer Bus, JBM EV, Kalmar, XCMG, LGMG
claims.source_quote: We have supported the deployment of the IVECO eDaily and various bus platforms (Citybus, Intercity, and Crossway). We also maintain active collaborations with leading OEMs including BAIC Truck, Higer Bus, and JBM Electric Vehicles. In the port and mining sectors, we have supplied Kalmar Corp., XCMG, and LGMG.

claims.claim_text: Restatement of Q2 and Q3 2024 financial statements (related to Clarksville facility impairment accounting); material weakness in internal controls.
claims.subject: Microvast
claims.object_value: Q2 2024 and Q3 2024 quarterly statements restated for Clarksville impairment error
claims.source_quote: We determined that our previously reported financial statements as of and for the quarterly periods ended June 30, 2024 and September 30, 2024, required restatement primarily to correct an error we identified relating to the previously recorded impairment associated with the Company's industrial facility located in Clarksville, Tennessee.
